focuses.desc:
China has surrendered. Japan holds the coast; Wang Jingwei's RNG holds the interior for Tokyo. What is left of the Nationalist government has fallen back to eastern Gansu behind the Central Army's last divisions. In Lanzhou, General Hu Zongnan - once the man who blockaded Yan'an from Xi'an - now commands a state that is little more than an army with a capital.

The Northwestern Army Group still calls itself the government of China. Almost nobody else does.

HOW CHI BECOMES THE NORTHWESTERN ARMY GROUP (BUILT 2026-11-24, untested - tools/gen_jap_china_peace.py): when Japan's dictated peace fires, Nationalist China does not vanish.
- It takes Gansu (283, Lanzhou - the new capital), Gannan (753) and Guyuan (1045) from whichever Chinese country holds them (normally the Ma clique), and keeps whatever else it still owns (normally Ganzi/Chamdo).
- It becomes the Northwestern Army Group (cosmetic tag CHI_wif_nwa, flag wif_nwa), led by Hu Zongnan.
- It gets 12 divisions of basic 6-battalion 'Northwestern Infantry' (5 Gansu, 4 Gannan, 3 Guyuan) and 3000 rifles.
- It has a 2-year truce with every other Chinese country, so the Ma clique cannot take its land back at once.
- The Ma clique is never re-formed on these three states.
- A PLAYER on Nationalist China is still moved to RNG (the user's earlier rule) - say if the player should stay with the Northwestern Army instead.

This tree loads with it (to build: wif_nwa_focus). LENGTH: about 8 years, ending around 1950-52 in step with the RNG and PRC trees. The last focus, The March Back East, waits for RNG's collapse (wif_rng_collapse_begun) or 1951. The real crisis comes in a later addition.

STARTING SPIRITS (proposed):
- The Retreat to the Northwest: -15% stability, -10% war support, -10% division organisation. Removed by the army branch.
- Refugee Columns: +5% recruitable population, +10% consumer goods - officers, officials and their families from every lost province.
- A Government Without a Country: -20% political power gain. Eased by the legitimacy focuses.

FUNDING THE RESISTANCE IN RNG (decisions, to build - the Nationalist side of the RNG tree's Three Resistances):
  Fund the Loyalist Army:
    Smuggle Officers Through the Lines - 25 political power: Loyalist Army +3.
    Send Silver - 50 political power: +4, and their Assassination needs 10 less strength for 180 days.
    Juntong Instructors (after Dai Li's Juntong) - 50 political power: Loyalist operations against mines and factories cost 10% less.
    Name the Target - 35 political power: choose the Loyalists' next operation.
  Fund the Liberation League:
    Fund the League - 25 political power: Liberation League +3, League Allegiance -10 (towards the Nationalists).
  Each funding decision raises Japan's suspicion (opinion -5, stacking); at -50 Japan may launch a Punitive Expedition against Lanzhou.

LEAGUE ALLEGIANCE: shared with the PRC tree (-100 Nationalist to +100 Communist).

THE BLOCKADE OF YAN'AN: the PRC starts with The Blockade. This tree can keep it up (Tighten the Blockade) or lift it (A New United Front, if both sides choose it).
